caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the model's Eval PPL (evaluated perplexity) under different sparsity settings applied to the Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) components at varying ratios of activated parameters, with the x-axis representing the "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)" on a logarithmic scale ranging from 25% to 100%, and the y-axis showing "Eval PPL" on a linear scale from 11.5 to 14.0. Four distinct configurations are compared: "Transformer" (dashed red line), "Only MoHD FFN" (gray dashed line), "Only MoHD ATTN" (dark blue solid line), and "MoHD ATTN + MLP" (light blue solid line). The "Transformer" baseline remains constant at an Eval PPL of 11.7 across all sparsity levels. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration shows a slight decrease in Eval PPL from 11.7 at 100% to 11.6 at 50%, followed by a slight increase to 11.7 at 25%. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration exhibits a significant increase in Eval PPL, starting at 11.7 at 100%, rising to 12.1 at 50%, and reaching 14.1 at 25%. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration also shows a steady increase, starting at 11.7 at 100%, rising to 12.1 at 50%, and reaching 13.1 at 25%. Overall, the "Only MoHD ATTN" and "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configurations demonstrate a notable increase in Eval PPL as the activated parameter ratio decreases, while the "Only MoHD FFN" configuration remains relatively stable.
